questions.prompt: Which of these are fielding positions in cricket?
questions.fact: Silly point stands a few metres from the batter, which is exactly why it is called silly.

questions.prompt: Which of these spices come from a seed?
questions.fact: Nutmeg and mace come from the same fruit. Nutmeg is the seed and mace is the red lace wrapped round it.

questions.prompt: How long is the Panama Canal, in kilometres?
questions.fact: About 82 km, and a ship takes around 8 to 10 hours to pass through it.

questions.prompt: How old was Mozart when he died?
questions.fact: 35. He wrote more than 600 pieces of music, and started composing at five.

questions.prompt: In which sport do teams play for the Webb Ellis Cup?
questions.hint: It is named after a schoolboy said to have picked up the ball and run with it.
questions.fact: The story says William Webb Ellis invented rugby at Rugby School in 1823, though there is little proof it happened.

questions.prompt: Which kind of music came from Jamaica?
questions.fact: Reggae grew out of ska and rocksteady in the late 1960s.
